title: Northstar-to-roadmap projection and cross-team synchronizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: produce a repeatable projection model and operational protocol that maps company-level OKRs (Northstar metrics) to a 90-day roadmap with clear ownership, capacity estimates, gating criteria, and a visual convergence heatmap for executive review. The outcome should make trade-offs explicit (impact, confidence, effort), enable weekly cross-team convergence, and be surfaced in the roadmap planning workflow (Pretend Console planning board + shared spreadsheet + dashboard).
acceptance_criteria: A1: For each company OKR, a primary initiative owner and up to three supporting teams are identified with a single-line hypothesis and target metric.
A2: The projection model quantifies expected delta toward Northstar per initiative (expressed as % of target) and required engineering capacity in FTE-weeks.
A3: Convergence heatmap (impact vs confidence vs effort) created for all initiatives and accessible in the planning dashboard.
A4: A documented gating protocol (Draft -> Can-Plan -> Committed -> Rollout) with sign-off roles (PM lead, Eng TL, Design lead, Data lead) is published and used in one planning cycle trial.
A5: Dependencies to Dedicated/Runtime work and security reviews are enumerated and owners assigned, with outstanding blockers tracked in the planning board.
A6: Executive review packet (1 pager + heatmap + risks) is prepared and accepted by GTM and CTO stakeholders.
A7: The process is trialed in one cycle and retrospective notes captured with at least 3 concrete improvements for next cycle.
A8: Dashboards show projected attainment vs OKR targets and a per-initiative estimated weeks-to-deliver field.
comments: 2026-02-15: Ticket created after Q1 strategy sync. Initial ask from CEO: make OKR-to-roadmap mapping auditable and comparable across teams. Assigned to Marco.
2026-02-18: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Northstar+Projection+Model (PRD draft). Key invites: Eng leads (runtime, infra, console), Design, Data, Sales Ops.

2026-02-22: Decision: use a 3-factor projection model (impact %, confidence score 1-5, estimated FTE-weeks). Rationale: balances quantitative rigor with speed for planning; avoids over-engineering an econometric model this quarter.

2026-02-26: Trade-offs discussed in follow-up: high-confidence low-impact initiatives will be deprioritized compared to medium-confidence high-impact initiatives; we will surface that in the heatmap and recommend gating policy to prefer 2:1 impact-to-effort ratio when capacity constrained.

2026-03-02: Data team prototype: mapping script that ingests OKR target baselines and historical feature uplift from past 4 quarters. Script: https://github.com/redwood-inference/okr-projection/blob/main/etl/estimate.py (PR opened PR#432).

2026-03-04: Design reviewed heatmap mockups. Feedback: add an accessibility-friendly color scale and allow toggles for effort metric (FTE vs cost $). Mock: Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF_heatmap-design

2026-03-06: Engineering feedback: runtime and dedicated capacity workstreams have long lead times; tagged as dependency ENG-19742 (Dedicated autoscale infra) and ENG-19888 (KV cache perf uplift). Eng requests early gating to avoid mid-cycle resource contention.
2026-03-08: PM alignment: agreed on weekly 45-minute convergence sync (Thursdays) with rotating facilitator. Agenda template added to Confluence. Meeting invites sent to leads.
2026-03-10: Draft gating protocol posted for review: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Gating+Protocol+Draft. Asked Eng and Security for review by 2026-03-16.

2026-03-12: Executive packet draft created and shared with GTM/Sales for input (shared doc link). Action: incorporate customer-usage hotspots to better weight impact scores (assigned to Data: Priya Mehta).
